note: Toddler-friendly events near North Portland, Vancouver and the coast, soonest first. Many holiday dates come from guides or listings rather than the organizers, so check before going.

events.title: Chrysanthemum Festival
events.detail: A floral design showcase with illuminated evenings at Lan Su Chinese Garden. $18.00.

events.title: Sing, Sign & Play @ SWPMA PLAY! at The Multnomah Arts Center
events.detail: Playtime involving singing, sign language, and movement in a soft space. $5 – $25.

events.title: Mini Movers at Laurelhurst Park!
events.detail: A playful class using props and storytelling to get toddlers moving. $18.

events.title: Morning Music with Mr. Ben at ModHaus
events.detail: Interactive singalong for babies, toddlers, and preschoolers. Price: Free; tips appreciated.

events.title: Curiosity Kids: Sasquatch Science Team
events.detail: A science activity for kids from 9 am to 10 am.

events.title: Pittock Mansion: Home for the Holidays
events.detail: The mansion decorated for 'Holidays from Around the World'; Travel Portland lists Nov. 16, 2026 to Jan. 10, 2027, with days and times that vary.

events.title: ZooLights
events.detail: Wildlife-themed holiday lights. A third-party guide reports Nov. 20, 2026 to Jan. 3, 2027, opening at 4:30 p.m., with tickets for specific dates; the zoo hasn't fully posted its 2026 calendar. Go early in the evening with little ones.

events.title: U-cut Christmas trees at Sauvie Island Farms
events.detail: The farm's blog says its U-cut tree field opens Nov. 21 to Dec. 24, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., self-serve on the honor system; all trees $60, cash or Venmo.

events.title: Topaz Farm Holiday Market and Christmas trees
events.detail: Holiday market with Christmas trees, wreaths and garlands; a community event listing reports opening day Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, 10 a.m. to noon. Season hours not yet confirmed by the farm.

events.title: Winter Wonderland drive-through lights
events.detail: Drive-through holiday light show benefiting Sunshine Division; a BringFido listing gives Nov. 27 to Dec. 31, 2026 with evening hours. Easy with a toddler since you stay in the car.

events.title: Christmas Festival of Lights at The Grotto
events.detail: Holiday lights and choir concerts, 5 to 9:30 p.m. nightly (grounds close at 10), closed Christmas Day, per The Grotto.

events.title: Holiday Express steam train
events.where: Oregon Rail Heritage Center, Southeast Portland
events.detail: A 45-minute round-trip holiday train ride along the Willamette on select dates Nov. 27 to Dec. 27, per the rail center. Exact 2026 run dates were still listed as coming soon; infants under 3 ride free on a lap.

events.title: Vancouver Community Tree Lighting
events.where: Vancouver Waterfront and Esther Short Park, Vancouver WA
events.detail: Free Rotary Club tree lighting with Santa arriving by tugboat; Explore Washington State reports Friday, Nov. 27, 2026. Time not yet confirmed by the organizer.

events.title: Pioneer Courthouse Square Tree Lighting
events.detail: Free annual tree lighting and singalong the day after Thanksgiving. The Nov. 27 date comes from an event listing; The Square hasn't posted its 2026 page yet.

events.title: Seaside Yuletide Parade of Lights
events.detail: Lighted holiday parade that ends at the downtown tree-lighting ceremony; Visit the Oregon Coast lists Nov. 27, 2026. Start time not yet confirmed by the organizer.

events.title: Curiosity Kids: Design and Discover
events.detail: A design activity for kids from 9 am to 10 am.

events.title: Christmas Ships Parade
events.detail: Lighted boat parades on both rivers; Carnifest reports Dec. 3 to 20, 2026. Nightly routes are posted on christmasships.org, and parades can be cancelled for weather.

events.title: La Center Christmas Festival
events.detail: Small-town Christmas festival with a tree lighting; Explore Washington State lists Dec. 4 to 6, 2026. Times not yet confirmed by the organizer.

events.title: Cannon Beach Lamp Lighting Ceremony
events.detail: Free Haystack Holidays tradition where the town lights its Christmas tree and gas lamps, 4 p.m., per the Cannon Beach Chamber.

events.title: Pizza with Santa
events.detail: City of Vancouver event, 6 to 8 p.m.; registration required, $12 for Vancouver residents.
